decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the detached garage and extension are occupied.
Condition : 4 - The extension hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes ancillary to the residential use of the dwelling known as25 Manor Avenue.

Condition : 5 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the north wall of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 6 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the side walls of the detached garage hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 7 - The drive through at ground floor level shall be provided before the extension is occupied and thereafter it shall be kept open internally to allow the free passage of private cars for parking at the rear

Condition : 8 - The detached garage hereby approved shall be used for the parking of private motor vehicles and for purposes ancillary to the use of 25 Manor Avenue as a single family dwellinghouse, and for no other purpose
description: Erection of two storey side extension an incorporating garage to dwellinghouse and erection of detached garage.
